QuestInfo.name: Rivalry of Convenience
QuestInfo.0: The Dark Lord is calling for you.
QuestInfo.1: Working with JM From tha Streetz and Nella, you took out plenty of Crocos, but the Dark Lord is concerned there are still too many. Eliminate more Crocos in the #m103030200# territory and report back to the Dark Lord.
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated the Crocos and reported to the Dark Lord.

0.0: When I first sent you out into the city, I told you not to trust anyone. Then you went into Kerning and played both sides. I'm...I'm proud of you.
0.1: You took advantage of Nella and JM's competition with each other, and reaped the benefits.
0.2: Enough of this sentimental chattering. Go out and eliminate some more Crocos.

yes.0: I would have you eliminate 50 of them. Now go!

no.0: You dare turn me down? Fool!

yes.0: You did...good work. You've come a long way, kid. All right, enough of that. Go see how #bNella#k's doing.

mob.0: I'm asking very little of you. Are you telling me you can't even handle a measly 50 Crocos?
